facts.note: At the bell striking nine, Aurèle had the watches inspected, and Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell.

Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch; he went to the hall for his cigar case from his coat; Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back. The transcript calls her Odile, which matches Madame in the fact sheet.
The hall clock struck eleven a moment after Vauthier sat down again.
